This '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' served as an escort for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was [[Mission to Death Star I|infiltrated]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agent [[X2]], who used the ship's own weapons to destroy defensive emplacements on the Death Star itself. With the emplacements eliminated, X2 was able to slip aboard the Death Star and gather intelligence on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Finally, he used the Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] to destroy the Star Destroyer.
